entries.0ab169a57d65f623: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells press machines and provides services in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, India, Vietnam and the Philippines. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,477 million (up 3.2% from the previous year), the smallest of the 5 reportable segments. Segment profit was ¥206 million (down 59.7% from the previous year). The breakdown was press machines ¥5,190 million, services ¥2,251 million and other ¥36 million. AIDA ENGINEERING (M) SDN.BHD. and AIDA MANUFACTURING (ASIA) SDN.BHD. in Malaysia manufacture the products, and AIDA GREATER ASIA PTE.LTD. in Singapore and others handle sales and services. The securities report states that sales of general-purpose press machines increased but sales of high-speed press machines decreased, and that segment profit fell owing to factors such as a lower gross margin.

entries.1ae3bd920c5f2b49: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥78,647 million, up 3.5% year on year. The annual securities report cites an increase in service revenue and the inclusion of the revenue of the acquired US subsidiary as reasons for the revenue increase. Orders received were ¥69,726 million (up 11.4% year on year), and order backlog was ¥54,383 million (down 14.1%). By region (revenue from external customers), the Americas rose 21.1% year on year to ¥21,758 million, and Japan fell 1.9% to ¥26,038 million.
entries.1c869dc73474fdae: [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual securities report]] states that the Group (the company and its domestic and overseas subsidiaries) consists of the company and 22 consolidated subsidiaries (2 in Japan, 20 overseas), and its main business is the manufacture and sale of forming machinery, centered on press machines among metal-working machinery, together with various automation devices for press-processing automation, industrial robots and dies, and related services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥78,647 million: press machines ¥51,755 million, services ¥19,645 million and other ¥7,246 million. The annual securities report states that product revenue from the automotive industry accounts for at least 3/4 of the total, and that the rise and fall of business conditions and capital investment trends in the automotive industry may have a material effect on the Group's business, results and financial condition.

entries.305d6d823f470ee6: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,690 million (up 2.9% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥5,735 million (up 3.2%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥4,260 million (down 16.5%). Gross profit was ¥17,547 million (up 9.4%). The annual securities report states that, in addition to the effect of higher revenue, operating profit increased due to improvements in business mix and in the gross margin of press machines, among other factors. It states that the decline in net income was due to a smaller gain on sale of policy-held shares and the absence of a tax effect that had been applied in the previous year in connection with the integration of a German subsidiary, among other factors.
entries.32f21451b5632b8b: A reportable segment in which the company itself, mainly in Japan, manufactures and sells press machines and provides services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,038 million (down 1.9% from the previous year), the largest of the 5 reportable segments. The breakdown was press machines ¥14,772 million, services ¥6,541 million and other ¥4,724 million. Segment profit was ¥2,997 million (up 6.7% from the previous year). REJ Co., Ltd. (㈱ＲＥＪ), a consolidated subsidiary in Japan, manufactures and sells drive units for industrial machinery and also provides services. The securities report states that although revenue (¥42,743 million including inter-segment transactions) fell 8.3% from the previous year owing to a decrease in general-purpose press machines and high-speed press machines, profit increased owing to improved profitability of individual press machines and an increase in service revenue. Most of the R&D expenses of ¥1,013 million are recorded in this segment.
entries.401e98589cc5d74e: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells press machines and provides services, mainly in Italy and also in Germany and Morocco. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,575 million (down 1.0% from the previous year), and segment profit was ¥190 million (down 5.9% from the previous year). The breakdown was press machines ¥8,430 million, services ¥5,125 million and other ¥19 million. AIDA S.r.l. (Italy) handles manufacturing, sales and services, and the securities report states that it accounts for more than 90% of the revenue of "Europe" in the segment information. In 2004, it took over part of the press machine manufacturing and sales business of MANZONI GROUP S.p.A., an Italian press machine manufacturer. The securities report states that sales of individual press machines and services increased, but sales of general-purpose press machines and high-speed press machines decreased.

entries.867c5489105631ce: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells press machines, provides services, and manufactures and sells automation and conveyance equipment, mainly in the United States and also in Canada, Mexico and Brazil. The breakdown was press machines ¥14,545 million, services ¥4,801 million and other ¥2,410 million. AIDA AMERICA CORP. (Ohio, United States) handles manufacturing, sales and services, while HMS Products Co., all of whose shares were acquired in April 2025, and Dallas Industries (official name: Advanced Feedlines, LLC), all of whose equity interests were acquired in October 2025, manufacture and sell automation and conveyance equipment and other products. The securities report states that revenue increased owing to higher press machine and service sales combined with the sales of the acquired U.S. subsidiaries, and that the decrease in segment profit was due to factors such as higher selling, general and administrative expenses.
